payload.text: **Close 0088 (mine to close)** -- released when vc lands a fix for the 10:0xZ finding on fb991dd (a tool started by an @builtin function inherits the terminal: probe tool read EOF at 3801e56, tool read: y at fb991dd; recommended fix: every gate gets </dev/null, and clean asks on a DEVBIN_GATE_TTY flag that run_gate records), dc re-runs the probe and arms with mutants, and a full suite ends green. The 09:34Z suite ended 1413 ok / 4 not ok; vc fixed those four at fb991dd.
